title: Oracle E-Business Suite unauthenticated SQLi-to-RCE (TCF servlet): exploit attempts seen in the wild days after the October CPU
why: Defused Cyber's EBS decoys recorded exploratory exploit attempts on Oct 27 (reported by BleepingComputer, The Hacker News and SecurityWeek). Public GitHub PoC/lab repos appeared on Oct 27, and Horizon3 has published the attack chain. It is not in CISA KEV: the KEV feed had no new entries this run. Oracle has not tagged it as exploited. Not a Microsoft product. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Apply the October 2026 CPU (MOS Note KA923) to every EBS 12.2.3-12.2.15 instance. Until then, remove /OA_HTML/AppsTCFServer from the EBS URL firewall allowlist, then hunt for unauthenticated POSTs to that path and for the oracle account spawning /bin/sh.
product: Oracle E-Business Suite 12.2.3 through 12.2.15 (Application Object Library, Core; /OA_HTML/AppsTCFServer)

title: GitLab CI regex RCE (CVSS 10, Onigmo) added to CISA KEV after attempted exploitation of Alpine Linux's GitLab
why: CISA added it to KEV on Oct 29 citing active exploitation; Microsoft's tracking signal is now in place.
action: Confirm all self-managed GitLab instances run the Oct 12 or later security release and review CI configuration changes and runner/server process trees since Oct 12.
product: GitLab CE/EE (fixed Oct 12 releases); self-built Ruby needs 3.3.13/3.4.12/4.0.9

title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN auth bypass (KEV) used by UAT-11473 to plant KeyDrift key-stealing malware; infra overlaps Volt Typhoon Silent Train
why: Not ahead: CVE-2026-20127 has been in CISA KEV since February (due 27 Feb 2026). The new information is Talos's Oct 28 KeyDrift report.
action: Confirm every SD-WAN controller is on a fixed build, then hunt: check /var/log/auth.log for 'Accepted publickey for vmanage-admin' from unknown IPs, modified runit scripts under /etc/sv/, libdssl.so, a fake aaamgr service and /var/tmp/vdaemon.* files; enable Snort 2 rules 67387-67416 (off by default). Plan key rotation if compromised.
product: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller, Manager and Validator (on-prem and Cisco-hosted) before 20.9.8.2 / 20.12.6.1 / 20.15.4.2 / 20.18.2.1; releases before 20.9 must migrate

title: SonicWall SMA1000 pre-auth SSRF (CVSS 10.0): honeypot exploitation attempts since Oct 8, still not in CISA KEV
why: Previdian and Defused Cyber honeypots have recorded exploitation attempts against CVE-2026-102255 since Oct 8, reported by THN, SecurityWeek and BleepingComputer. It was not in CISA KEV as of catalog 2026.10.21 (Safeguard check), and the KEV additions on Oct 23 and Oct 26 did not include it. SonicWall's advisory still says there is no evidence of exploitation, and no successful compromise has been publicly confirmed. Rechecked Oct 28: the Oct 27 KEV additions (PolyShell, Brotli) do not include it. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Upgrade every SMA1000 to 12.4.3-03670 or 12.5.0-03082 or later, restrict Work Place exposure, and review appliance logs since Oct 6 for requests to internal services.
product: SonicWall SMA1000 6210/7210/8200v, 12.4.3-03526 and older, 12.5.0-02952 and older (includes the September fix builds)

title: Cisco ASA/FTD SSL VPN DoS zero-day (CVSS 8.6) added to CISA KEV
why: CISA added it to KEV on Oct 29; no longer ahead of Microsoft.
action: Apply Cisco's Oct 28 fixed ASA/FTD releases and monitor for unexpected device reloads.
product: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA and FTD Software (fixed releases Oct 28)

title: Gotenberg unauthenticated RCE (ExifTool metadata-key injection, CVSS 9.8) exploited in the wild by multiple actors; not in CISA KEV
why: VulnCheck canaries recorded 1,358 exploitation events from 128 source IPs over 30 days, including an actor dropping a custom Go reverse shell (cache_base) in early October (VulnCheck blog, analysis Oct 24; THN ThreatsDay Oct 29); a separate cryptomining campaign is documented by The Hunter's Ledger. A public PoC and Nuclei template exist. VulnCheck notes it is NOT in CISA KEV (VulnCheck KEV since June). Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade every Gotenberg container to 8.31.0 or later, keep port 3000 off untrusted networks behind an authenticating proxy, and hunt for POSTs to /forms/pdfengines/metadata/write and unexpected outbound connections from Gotenberg containers.
product: Gotenberg before 8.31.0 (/forms/pdfengines/metadata/write endpoint)

title: Microsoft Edge logic-bug-only sandbox escape chain (Pwn2Own Berlin) published in full; fixed in May
why: Not ahead: Microsoft fixed the chain on May 15 in Edge 148.0.3967.70 (CVE-2026-45492/45494/45495 published by MSRC). No in-the-wild use reported.
action: Confirm no managed Edge is older than 148.0.3967.70 (check for pinned or frozen versions in VDI and kiosk images).
product: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) before 148.0.3967.70

title: EDK II PXE driver pre-boot RCE (CVSS4 9.5): Microsoft Project Mu ships fix, still no EDK II stable release or OEM firmware
why: TianoCore advisory GHSA-99cj-7hg9-mp4m, with Ars Technica, The Hacker News (Oct 28) and an oss-security thread (Oct 28). Microsoft's Project Mu fork has pulled the fix and tagged builds on Oct 26. Upstream EDK II still has no stable release with the fix, and the advisory reads 'Not patched currently'. No MSRC advisory, not in CISA KEV, no PoC or in-the-wild use reported. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Disable PXE/UEFI network stack where not needed, keep PXE on isolated provisioning VLANs, and track OEM firmware and distro edk2/OVMF updates for CVE-2026-97631.
vendor: TianoCore (EDK II); downstream AMI, Insyde, Phoenix, Project Mu, OVMF
product: EDK II NetworkPkg UefiPxeBcDxe up to edk2-stable202608 (fix merged Oct 15, PR 13302); vendor firmware updates pending

title: NUUO Crystal Server 3.19.0.85 unauthenticated upload.php web-root write to code execution: unpatched 0-day with claimed PoC
why: 0day Rubbish Research Team posted the unauthenticated upload-to-RCE on Full Disclosure Oct 28 with no vendor coordination and a claimed working PoC; no vendor advisory, no CVE, not in CISA KEV. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Keep NUUO Crystal management interfaces off the internet and restrict them to admin networks until NUUO ships a fix.
product: NUUO Crystal Server 3.19.0.85 (Crystal VM appliance)

title: Linux kernel IPv4 TCP handshake use-after-free (CVSS 9.8): Anthropic demonstrated zero-click remote root on MPTCP listeners; Ubuntu/RHEL fixes pending, not in KEV
why: Anthropic's Oct 27 research post describes a working (unpublished) exploit giving unauthenticated remote root on servers with a multipath TCP listener; Go announced Oct 29 that Go 1.24+ programs enable MPTCP on listeners by default (oss-security/golang-announce). Innora published a root-cause analysis and QEMU reproduction environment but no weaponized exploit. No exploitation in the wild reported, and as of Oct 29 not in CISA KEV (Rescana, THN). Ubuntu and RHEL have not shipped fixed kernels. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Patch and reboot Linux hosts where a fixed kernel exists; on Ubuntu/RHEL prioritise internet-facing hosts with MPTCP listeners (Go 1.24+ services), set net.mptcp.enabled=0 where MPTCP is not needed, or drop IPv4 packets with options at the edge until fixed kernels ship.

title: Hugging Face trust_remote_code malware campaign returns: fake Qwen2 models drop GPU miners, reverse shells and SSH backdoors on inference servers
why: Pluto Security found 31 malicious repos across seven Hugging Face accounts; a second wave appeared within days of takedown and a near-identical model uploaded Oct 25 was still live when BleepingComputer checked (Oct 29). Flagship model reached 28,412 downloads. No CVE; no Microsoft advisory or KEV entry applies, and the article notes HF's scanners do not analyse bundled Python code.
action: Disable trust_remote_code by default, allowlist model sources, and check GPU inference hosts against Pluto Security's published indicators (via the BleepingComputer article); treat any host that loaded these models as compromised and rotate its credentials.
vendor: Hugging Face Hub (abused); targets Xinference, GPUStack
product: Self-hosted inference servers loading Hub models with trust_remote_code enabled

title: FortiSandbox GUI unauthenticated auth bypass to command execution (CVSS 9.6, vendor E:F)
why: Fortinet FG-IR-26-185 and ZDI-26-771 describe the flaw, and Fortinet's vector carries E:F, but no public exploit has been found. Not in CISA KEV. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Upgrade FortiSandbox to 5.0.7 or 4.4.10 and restrict the management GUI to admin networks.

title: Tailworm: Tailscale 1.104.4 fixes SSH socket-forwarding root escalation and three more flaws (TS-2026-014 to 017), no CVEs
why: The researcher (Cyberdione Labs) published full details on Oct 25. Tailscale shipped 1.104.4 with bulletins TS-2026-014 to 017 on Oct 27. There are no CVE IDs, no in-the-wild reports, and it is not in KEV. The headscale findings remain unfixed. Not a Microsoft product. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Upgrade all Tailscale nodes to 1.104.4. Where you cannot, set TS_SSH_DISABLE_FORWARDING=1. On headscale, treat every SSH grant as root on the target.
product: Tailscale client before 1.104.4 (Tailscale SSH with forwarding, Serve); headscale up to 0.29.6 control-server findings not fixed by the client release

title: Supermicro BMC IPMI: unsigned, unencrypted commands accepted on live sessions (CVSS 9.8 CNA), plus 7 more BMC CVEs
why: Supermicro published advisories on Oct 26 and runZero (HD Moore) published research the same day. NVD published the CVEs on Oct 27. None of the nine CVEs was in CISA KEV at Rescana's check on Oct 27. No public PoC and no in-the-wild use reported. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Apply the BMC firmware Supermicro lists for each board, and keep IPMI (UDP 623) reachable only from an isolated management network.
product: Supermicro BMC firmware on select X12/X13 and other pre-X14 motherboards (X14 affected by CVE-2026-65213); fixed BMC firmware listed per board, two boards still TBD

title: WatchGuard Fireware OS: unauthenticated SIP-proxy RCE, FireCluster admin-action and Access Portal heap overflow among 18 Firebox fixes
why: WatchGuard published 18 Fireware OS advisories on Oct 27, seven of them CVSS 9.1 or higher, including an unauthenticated SIP-proxy stack overflow (CVE-2026-93857). WatchGuard says it knows of no exploitation and there is no public PoC (SecurityOnline, VulDB). None of the CVEs is in CISA KEV, even though earlier WatchGuard flaws are. Not a Microsoft product. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Upgrade Fireboxes to Fireware OS 2026.4, 12.12.4 or 12.5.22. Until then, disable the SIP proxy and Access Portal where unused, isolate FireCluster links and restrict management interfaces.
product: Fireware OS before 2026.4 / 12.12.4 / 12.5.22 (Firebox appliances)

title: jackson-databind polymorphic-typing validator bypass via generic type arguments (CVSS 9.8), incomplete fix for CVE-2026-54512
why: The NVD record (Oct 28) and the GHSA advisory describe a working bypass: a gadget class wrapped in a generic type argument gets past the validator, with demonstrated Spring FileSystemXmlApplicationContext command execution. Not in CISA KEV and no in-the-wild reports. Not a Microsoft product. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Upgrade jackson-databind to 2.18.12, 2.21.8, 2.22.4, 3.1.8 or 3.2.4, and find any use of activateDefaultTyping or @JsonTypeInfo(use=CLASS) on untrusted input.

title: MLflow unauthenticated RCE via third-party scorer deserialization importing caller-placed artifact modules (CVSS 9.8)
why: The GitHub advisory GHSA-26p8-2jq9-3vq9 (Oct 27) describes RCE on unauthenticated MLflow servers. No PoC or in-the-wild use has been reported and it is not in CISA KEV. Not a Microsoft product. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Upgrade MLflow to 3.17.0 or later and put tracking servers behind authentication; never expose them to untrusted networks.
product: mlflow 3.12.0rc0 up to before 3.17.0

title: Brazilian Magecart group compromises Convertr's shared Plausible analytics script, skimming cards on all Convertr checkouts since Oct 24
why: Sansec research (OTX pulse, Oct 27) and BleepingComputer report an active supply-chain skimmer on every Convertr checkout since Oct 24. There is no CVE or vendor advisory. Not a Microsoft product and not in KEV. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Convertr merchants should remove the third-party analytics script, enforce a CSP that blocks unknown script origins, and warn customers who checked out since Oct 24.
product: Convertr e-commerce platform checkouts (Brazil) loading the tampered analytics script

title: Dell PowerProtect Data Domain DSA-2026-416: unauthenticated root RCE, auth bypass and hard-coded key flaws (CVSS 9.8)
why: Dell advisory DSA-2026-416, with the CVEs published to NVD on Oct 28. Several flaws give an unauthenticated remote attacker root command execution or privileged account creation. No public exploit and no exploitation reported. Not in CISA KEV. Not a Microsoft product. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Upgrade DD OS to 8.9.0.0, 8.6.1.30, 8.3.1.50 or 7.13.1.90 or later, and restrict Data Domain/DDMC management interfaces to a dedicated management VLAN.

title: Juniper Session Smart Router/Conductor (JSA112183): two unauthenticated CVSS 9.8 flaws - admin takeover of un-onboarded routers and root command injection on Conductor
why: Juniper published bulletin JSA112183 on Oct 28 fixing 18 SSR flaws, including two unauthenticated 9.8s (NVD, SecurityOnline). They are not in CISA KEV. No public exploit or in-the-wild use has been reported yet. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Upgrade SSR and Conductor to 7.0.5/7.1.7/7.2.3, onboard staged routers to Mist/Conductor before exposing them, and restrict Conductor's management and salt ports to trusted networks.
product: Session Smart Router and Session Smart Conductor before 7.0.5, 7.1.7, 7.2.3

title: Sophos UTM (end-of-life) unauthenticated root RCE via email-proxy path traversal race; manual patch only
why: Sophos published a pre-auth RCE advisory and CVE on Oct 28 (CNA CVSS4 9.2), and its community blog urges urgent action for UTM Email Protection users. It is not in CISA KEV and no public exploit has been seen. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Install Sophos's manual UTM patch now or turn off email-proxy scanning, and plan to migrate off end-of-life UTM.
product: Sophos SG UTM, all versions (up to 9.724) with Email Protection proxy scanning enabled

title: Langflow OSS: IBM publishes 33 CVEs incl. unauthenticated RCEs (CVE-2026-110186, -104339) through 1.12.8; fixed only in 1.13.0
why: IBM bulletin 7294467 (Oct 28) and 33 CVE records (Oct 29) disclose unauthenticated code execution and auth bypass in every Langflow release through 1.12.8. HOL found no in-the-wild exploitation and none in CISA KEV as of Oct 29; a Metasploit module exists only for CVE-2026-93680 (tracked under the earlier Langflow ITW group, CVE-2026-0768). Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade Langflow to 1.13.0 (set LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD first; auto-login is disabled), keep Langflow behind an authenticating proxy, and rotate API keys stored in flows.
product: Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.8 (PyPI langflow, langflowai/langflow Docker); fixed in 1.13.0

title: Progress WS_FTP Server: unauthenticated admin-credential exposure (CVSS 10.0) plus 14 more flaws incl. 9.9 command injection
why: Progress released fixes Oct 29 for 15 WS_FTP Server flaws; CVE-2026-84295 lets an unauthenticated remote attacker obtain sensitive data including administrative credentials. No PoC or exploitation reported yet (SecurityOnline, OffSeq), and not in CISA KEV. Managed file transfer servers are a recurring mass-exploitation target. Runs on Windows but is not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade WS_FTP Server to 2025.0.4 or 2024.0.7 (covers all 15 CVEs), restrict the admin interface to management networks, and rotate WS_FTP administrator credentials after patching.

title: 0day-rubbish batch: authenticated command injection in Moxa MAR-2000 (3), Raritan PX3 PDU and NETGEAR RAX120, unpatched
why: Five 0-day disclosures posted on Full Disclosure Oct 28 by 0day Rubbish with claimed PoCs and no vendor coordination; no advisories, CVEs or KEV entries. Rechecked Oct 30: CISA's Oct 29 KEV additions were only GitLab 97229 and Cisco 76418; still not in KEV.
action: Restrict management access to these devices to trusted admin networks and rotate their admin credentials.
product: Moxa MAR-2000 FWR_MAR2000_V1.0_Build_15010909; Raritan PX3 PDU G4 firmware 4.3.14; NETGEAR RAX120 V1.2.5.18
